description: Suivi des passages à vélo - somme annuelle is a dataset listed in Observatoire du Climat open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Toulouse Métropole. Somme annuelle du nombre de passage vélo comptabilisé sur l'ensemble des sites (Boulevard Bonrepos, Avenue des Minimes et Avenue Etienne Billières). Coverage: Toulouse Métropole. The portal files it under Mobilité. Its keywords are vélo, mobilité, pratique, passage. The portal shows 4 records. The portal flags it as a time series. The portal shows 2026-02-02 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte v2.0 (Etalab). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support cycling and walking network and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-observatoire-climat-toulouse-metropole-portal.
